cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallTypeTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Type tray - allows only continuous walls
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallTypeTray --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --all_mounts 1 --back_height 30 --bottom_edge e --walltype slatwall --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallTypeTray --all_mounts --back_height --bottom_edge --walltype --reference --labels
